name: DOI
summary: A potent, long-acting psychedelic stimulant. Historically, it has rarely been consumed deliberately, but occasionally sold as LSD. However, it has recently found its own little nest in the research chemical community.

pharmacology.text: (R)-DOI and several other serotonergic psychedelics, including TCB-2, LSD, and LA-SS-Az, have been found to show potent inhibition of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFα)-induced inflammation. (R)-DOI was the most active of the assessed drugs and showed extremely high potency that was in the picomolar range and was an order of magnitude more potent than its action as a hallucinogen.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Anti-inflammatory agent

uses.text: It is little-used recreationally, but is widely used in scientific research in the study of psychedelics and serotonin receptors. The drug is taken orally. DOI has been encountered as a novel designer drug.
